provenance.data_policy: Every supplier, configuration, price, stock statement, warranty term, tax rate, and component specification below is tied to a public source URL. Values are time-stamped observations, not quotes or guarantees.
provenance.refresh_policy: Open every source again and capture the cart-ready configuration before approval or purchase-order creation.
provenance.planning_assumptions: Internal labor, utilization, maintenance reserve, discount rate, downtime exposure, and residual value come from the purchase request or resolved runtime configuration and are calculations, not supplier claims.
